name: JSON Formatter
description: Format, repair, minify, validate and visualize JSON. Runs entirely on your machine
help: Input is processed in real time by the local Rust engine; your data never leaves this machine.
Format / Minify / Validate support strict JSON as well as relaxed JSON5 (comments, trailing commas, single quotes).

Repair runs only when you click Start repair. Preview common syntax fixes, then choose Apply and format to replace the input with strict JSON. Ambiguous missing values, duplicate keys and truncated strings are rejected; the limit is 2 MiB, 127 nesting levels and 100,000 nodes.
Errors highlight the offending line; click “Go to error” to jump there.

JCS canonical: sorts keys by UTF-16 code units and normalizes string escapes and number formatting per RFC 8785. Only strict JSON is accepted; duplicate keys, lone surrogates and out-of-range numbers fail with a clear error.
The tree view loads nodes on demand so large files stay smooth; stats show type counts and nesting depth.
Compare performs a structural diff and lists added, removed and changed paths.
Export the diff as a JSON Patch (add / remove / replace / move with JSON Pointer paths) or a JSON Merge Patch for reviews and config sync.
